<!-- What this changes and why, and its issue ("Fixes #123"). CONTRIBUTING.md has the rules this list is from. -->

- [ ] Small, and on one topic
- [ ] Tests with every change in behaviour (a fix's test fails without it)
- [ ] Docs kept in step (`README.md`, `docs/`, `templates/`), and `CHANGELOG.md`'s Unreleased section if a roadmap repository would notice
- [ ] Screenshots of anything you can see change, before and after
- [ ] Safari (WebKit) first; Chrome, Edge and Firefox work too
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader use keeps working
- [ ] No new runtime dependency for the app, unless agreed in an issue
- [ ] Commit subjects are plain sentences of 72 characters at most; dates are YYYY-MM-DD
- [ ] The checks pass (CONTRIBUTING.md, "The checks")
